Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
Subject: Audio and video recordings of earnings call held on July 16, 2026 
  
This is further to our intimation dated July 10, 2026, informing the exchanges regarding the details of 
the earnings call scheduled on Thursday, July 16, 2026, at 5:30 p.m. (IST) to discuss the Company's 
performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. 
  
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015, we now wish to inform that the audio and video recordings of the earnings call held today i.e. 
July 16, 2026, are hosted on the website of the Company and are available at 
https://ir.360.one/investor-relations/reports-and-presentations/.  
 
We request you to kindly take the above information on record. 
 
Thanking you.
